tone_statements.translation: 3.3 Breathy tones split off, initial aspiration lost. The points of this type are Leli, Gaoba and Shidong; Leli belongs to the Southern first vernacular, Gaoba and Shidong to the Northern first vernacular. ... Table 4, tone categories and values of Leli, Gaoba and Shidong Kam [columns: tones 1, 1', 2, 3, 3', 4, 5, 5', 6, 7, 7', 8, 9, 9', 10]: Gaoba 35 11 22 33 13 31 55 24 44 55 24 13 33 13 31; Shidong 35 11 22 33 13 31 55 24 44 55 13 33 13 31 [no 7'] ... In Table 4, Leli and Gaoba Kam have a breathy tone split off from every yin tone, 15 tones in all; Shidong Kam has not split a breathy tone from tone 7 and has 14 tones; Gaoba and Shidong are geographically very close and apart from tone 7 all their tone values are identical. (The '...' marks stand for sentence punctuation that the defective text layer did not preserve and for omitted table rows.)

tone_statements.quote: 声调分全清与次清各地不完全一致，因而出现声调类别上的差异。这种差异大体上有三种类型：1、基本上阴调都已分化（简称9个调类型）。包括南部方言第一土语（榕江车江、通道陇城、三江程阳、龙胜平等、黎平洪州等地）和北部方言第一、第二土语（天柱石洞、剑河小广、锦屏启蒙、三穗款场、天柱注溪、新晃中寨等地），占侗语分布的大部分地区。... 北部方言入声的c调或x调与s调合并 ... 2、只有阴平分为全阴平和次阴平，其他阴调不分（简称7个调类型）。包括南部方言第四土语（融水聘洞）和北部方言第三土语（锦屏大同和靖州滥泥冲一带）。... 3、没有分化。即阴调仍然只有一类，没有全阴调和次阴调之别（简称6个调类型）。包括南部方言第二土语（黎平、从江的大部分和榕江北部等地）、第三土语（融水寨怀）和北部方言第四土语（镇远报京）。
tone_statements.translation: Whether tones distinguish plain from aspirated (yin) categories is not the same everywhere, which produces differences in tone categories. There are roughly three types: 1. essentially all yin tones have split (the '9-tone type'): the Southern first vernacular (Rongjiang Chejiang, Tongdao Longcheng, Sanjiang Chengyang, Longsheng Pingdeng, Liping Hongzhou etc.) and the Northern first and second vernaculars (Tianzhu Shidong, Jianhe Xiaoguang, Jinping Qimeng, Sansui Kuanchang, Tianzhu Zhuxi, Xinhuang Zhongzhai etc.), i.e. most of the Kam area. ... In the Northern dialect the checked c or x tone merges with the s tone ... 2. only the yin-ping tone splits into plain and aspirated yin-ping, the other yin tones do not (the '7-tone type'): the Southern fourth vernacular (Rongshui Pindong) and the Northern third vernacular (around Jinping Datong and Jingzhou Lannichong). ... 3. no split: the yin tones remain a single set (the '6-tone type'): the Southern second vernacular (most of Liping and Congjiang, northern Rongjiang), the third (Rongshui Zhaihuai) and the Northern fourth vernacular (Zhenyuan Baojing).
